1.en: At the time when the earth became hot
1.note: 开篇四行的解释分歧极大：有的注家读出宇宙的剧变，利留卡拉尼读作大地从黏液中升起、光明初现；Kelsey 与 Pokini Robinson 则认为是在宣告一位“灼热”（*wela*，指其禁忌等级）的圣子诞生。诸说见 [[ku:8]]。

2.en: At the time when the heavens turned about
2.note: *lole* 意为“翻转、里外倒置”。Beckwith 说不知天地被强行分开之说从何读入此字（[[ku:8]]）。

3.en: At the time when the sun was darkened
3.note: *kuka‘iaka*：*aka* 指“月亮初升时的微光”，也有“影”义；Poepoe 以此词指月亮（[[ku:8]]）。

4.en: To cause the moon to shine
4.note: 原文 *E ho‘omalamalama i ka malama*。Beckwith 怀疑夏威夷人是否以为月光来自太阳（[[ku:8]]）。

5.en: The time of the rise of the Pleiades
5.note: *Makali‘i* 即昴星团，也是一个月份的名称。Kelsey 说这是种子发芽、鱼类产卵、昴星高悬的季节；Pokini 说是太阳北返、生长季开始之时（[[ku:8]]）。

6.en: The slime, this was the source of the earth
6.note: *walewale*：深海底的黏液，生命由此而出；Pokini 指出它也是产妇产后七天洁净期的名称（[[ku:8]]）。*Aloha* 本作 *welawela*（炽热）（[[ku:8]]）。

7.en: The source of the darkness that made darkness
7.zh: 是幽暗之源，由此而幽暗
7.note: *lipo* 是洞穴深处或深海那样的幽暗，既指空间，也指颜色的深浅（[[ku:8]]）。

8.en: The source of the night that made night

9.en: The intense darkness, the deep darkness
9.zh: 深深的幽暗，深深的幽暗

10.en: Darkness of the sun, darkness of the night
10.zh: 白日的幽暗，黑夜的幽暗

11.note: 原文 *Po wale ho--‘i*。Kalākaua 本把下一行与此行连写，Beckwith 依 *Aloha* 本分作两行（附录二）。

13.en: Born was Kumulipo in the night, a male
13.zh: 夜里生了库穆利波，是男
13.note: 库穆利波（Kumulipo），Beckwith 释为“深黑之源”（Source-of-profundity）。全诗以他与下行的 Po‘ele 为第一对“生育者”（[[ku:9]]、[[essays/kumulipo]]）。

14.en: Born was Po'ele in the night, a female
14.note: Po‘ele，“黑夜”。前四段各有一对由暗转明的生育者：库穆利波与 Po‘ele、Pouliuli 与 Powehiwehi、Po‘ele‘ele 与 Pohaha、Popanopano 与 Polalowehi（[[ku:9]]）。

15.en: Born was the coral polyp, born was the coral, came forth
15.zh: 生了珊瑚虫，又生了其子珊瑚，出来了
15.note: *‘Uku-ko‘ako‘a*，“珊瑚的小虫”；*‘Ako‘ako‘a* 即珊瑚。Beckwith 指出，最先出生的是带硬壳的生物，这与神灵进入石头、石头便有生育力的波利尼西亚观念相合（[[ku:10]]）。

16.en: Born was the grub that digs and heaps up the earth, came forth
16.note: 原文此行没有 *puka*（出来了），Beckwith 的英译补上了。

17.en: Born was his [child] an earthworm, came forth
17.zh: 生了其子，是蚯蚓，出来了

18.en: Born was the starfish, his child the small starfish came forth
18.zh: 生了海星，其子小海星出来了

19.en: Born was the sea cucumber, his child the small sea cucumber came forth
19.zh: 生了海参，其子小海参出来了

20.en: Born was the sea urchin, the sea urchin [tribe]

21.en: Born was the short-spiked sea urchin, came forth
21.zh: 生了其子，是短刺海胆，出来了

22.en: Born was the smooth sea urchin, his child the long-spiked came forth
22.zh: 生了光滑的海胆，其子长刺海胆出来了

23.en: Born was the ring-shaped sea urchin, his child the thin-spiked came forth
23.zh: 生了环形的海胆，其子细刺海胆出来了

24.en: Born was the barnacle, his child the pearl oyster came forth
24.zh: 生了藤壶，其子珍珠贝出来了

25.en: Born was the mother-of-pearl, his child the oyster came forth
25.zh: 生了珍珠母贝，其子牡蛎出来了

26.en: Born was the mussel, his child the hermit crab came forth
26.zh: 生了贻贝，其子寄居蟹出来了

27.en: Born was the big limpet, his child the small limpet came forth
27.zh: 生了大笠贝，其子小笠贝出来了
27.note: *‘opihi* 是笠贝，至今仍是夏威夷人珍视的海味。

28.en: Born was the cowry, his child the small cowry came forth
28.zh: 生了宝螺，其子小宝螺出来了

29.en: Born was the naka shellfish, the rock oyster his child came forth
29.zh: 生了 naka 螺，其子岩牡蛎出来了

30.en: Born was the drupa shellfish, his child the bitter white shell fish came forth
30.zh: 生了核果螺，其子苦味的白螺出来了

31.en: Born was the conch shell, his child the small conch shell came forth
31.zh: 生了法螺，其子小法螺出来了

32.en: Born was the nerita shellfish, the sand-burrowing shellfish his child came forth
32.zh: 生了蜑螺，其子钻沙的螺出来了

33.en: Born was the fresh water shellfish, his child the small fresh water shellfish came forth
33.zh: 生了淡水螺，其子小淡水螺出来了
33.note: Kalākaua 本此行与下一行次序颠倒，Beckwith 已改正（附录二）。

34.en: Born was man for the narrow stream, the woman for the broad stream
34.zh: 生了男，属窄流之水；女，属宽流之水
34.note: *Wai‘ololi* 与 *Wai‘olola* 在日常语言里指水流急速涌入的窄口，和水流平缓漫入的宽阔海岸。Beckwith 认为这一行确指男女在生育中的角色，说的是海水与升起的陆地相接处生命的诞生（[[ku:9]]）。

35.en: Born was the Ekaha moss living in the sea
35.zh: 生了 ekaha 苔，居于海中
35.note: 以下每节一海一陆、两两成对，配对靠的是名字的谐音，而不是物种的亲缘。草药医生在服某种陆上药草之后，要先吃与它同名相配的海中之物（[[ku:9]]）。

36.en: Guarded by the Ekahakaha fern living on land
36.zh: 由 ekahakaha 蕨守护，居于陆上

37.note: 此行原文难解。手稿作 *He pou he‘e i ka wawa*。Beckwith 采用 Ho‘olapa 的译法“黑夜滑入光明”，并说并不满意：*wawa* 字面为“喧嚣”，她疑为 *waka*（闪光）之误。她另提出一种读法：若依手稿，*pou*（柱）与下行的 *nuku* 都可能是生殖的隐喻，与叠句首末两行同指受孕生长，但她没有找到夏威夷方面的证据（[[ku:9]]）。

38.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant
38.note: *nuku* 是难点：有人读作“巢”，有人读作“溅”或“争吵”，也有人当作指小词，读成“一点点水是树的食物”。Beckwith 勉强采用 Emory 的意见，以 *nuku* 为与“天”相对的“地”（正写当作 *nu‘u*），并据后几段此处换成 *hua*（果）与 *‘i‘o*（肉）来佐证（[[ku:9]]）。

39.en: The god enters, man can not enter
39.note: Beckwith 认为此行明白指出，使万物受孕生长的是神而不是人；可比照土阿莫土的说法“去往夜（*po*）的路属于神，去往昼（*ao*）的路属于人”（[[ku:9]]）。

40.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
40.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水
40.note: 此行起一节，下接海陆一对与三行叠句；每节以此行开头，叠句收尾（[[ku:9]]）。

41.en: Born was the touch seagrass living in the sea
41.zh: 生了坚韧的海草，居于海中
41.note: *‘aki‘aki* 是一种坚韧可食的海藻，与之相配的 *manienie* 是茎秆坚韧的草（[[ku:9]]）。英文 touch 当是 tough 之误，照录。

42.en: Guarded by the tough landgrass living on land
42.zh: 由坚韧的陆草守护，居于陆上

44.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

45.en: The god enters, man can not enter

46.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
46.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

47.en: Born was the 'Ala'ala moss living in the sea
47.zh: 生了 ‘a‘ala‘ula 海藻，居于海中
47.note: *‘a‘ala‘ula* 是一种可食海藻，Beckwith 说即 *Codium*，当时檀香山鱼市仍有出售。

48.en: Guarded by the 'Ala'ala mint living on land
48.zh: 由 ‘ala‘ala-wai-nui 香草守护，居于陆上
48.note: *‘ala‘ala-wai-nui*，Beckwith 记为 *Plectranthus australis*。据她说，草药医生给人服了这种药草之后，规定先吃的就是上行同名相配的海藻（[[ku:9]]）。

50.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

51.en: The god enters, man can not enter

52.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
52.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

53.en: Born was the Manauea moss living in the sea
53.zh: 生了 manauea 海藻，居于海中

54.en: Guarded by the Manauea taro plant living on land
54.zh: 由 manauea 芋守护，居于陆上

56.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

57.en: The god enters, man can not enter

58.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
58.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

59.en: Born was the Ko'ele seaweed living in the sea
59.zh: 生了 ko‘ele‘ele 海藻，居于海中

60.en: Guarded by the long-jointed sugarcane, the *ko 'ele'ele*, living on land
60.zh: 由长节的甘蔗、黑甘蔗守护，居于陆上
60.note: *ko* 即甘蔗，*‘ele‘ele* 意为“黑”，与上行海藻之名相应。

62.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

63.en: The god enters, man can not enter

64.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
64.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

65.en: Born was the Puaki seaweed living in the sea
65.zh: 生了 puaki 海藻，居于海中
65.note: Kalākaua 本作 *Puaiki* 与 *Lau aki*（附录二）。

66.en: Guarded by the Akiaki rush living on land
66.zh: 由 lauaki 灯心草守护，居于陆上

68.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

69.en: The god enters, man can not enter

70.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
70.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

71.en: Born was the Kakalamoa living in the sea

72.en: Guarded by the moamoa plant living on land
72.zh: 由 moamoa 草守护，居于陆上

74.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

75.en: The god enters, man can not enter

76.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
76.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

77.en: Born was the Kele seaweed living in the sea
77.zh: 生了 kele 海藻，居于海中

78.en: Guarded by the Ekele plant living on land
78.zh: 由 ekele 草守护，居于陆上

80.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

81.en: The god enters, man can not enter

82.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
82.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

83.en: Born was the Kala seaweed living in the sea
83.zh: 生了 kala 海藻，居于海中

84.en: Guarded by the 'Akala vine living on land
84.zh: 由 ‘akala 莓藤守护，居于陆上
84.note: *‘akala* 是夏威夷特有的悬钩子（*Rubus hawaiensis*）。

86.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

87.en: The god enters, man can not enter

88.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
88.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

89.en: Born was the Lipu'upu'u living in the sea

90.en: Guarded by the Lipu'u living on land
90.zh: 由 lipu‘u 守护，居于陆上

92.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

93.en: The god enters, man can not enter

94.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
94.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

95.en: Born was the Long-one living at sea
95.note: *Loloa*，“长的”；下行 *Kalamaloloa* 中含 *lama*（火炬）与 *loloa*，Beckwith 意译为“长炬”。

96.en: Guarded by the Long-torch living on land

98.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

99.en: The god enters, man can not enter

100.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
100.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

101.en: Born was the Ne seaweed living in the sea
101.zh: 生了 ne 海藻，居于海中

102.en: Guarded by the Neneleau [sumach] living on land
102.zh: 由 neneleau 盐肤木守护，居于陆上
102.note: *neneleau* 是夏威夷的盐肤木（*Rhus sandwicensis*）。

104.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

105.en: The god enters, man can not enter

106.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
106.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

107.en: Born was the hairy seaweed living in the sea
107.zh: 生了多毛的海藻，居于海中

108.en: Guarded by the hairy pandanus vine living on land
108.zh: 由多毛的 ‘ie‘ie 藤守护，居于陆上
108.note: *‘ie‘ie*（*Freycinetia arborea*）是攀缘的露兜藤，果穗顶端鲜红，被奉为森林生长之神，象征生育力；它的出现直接引出下行“持水葫芦的男子”（[[ku:10]]）。

110.en: Earth and water are the food of the plant

111.en: The god enters, man can not enter

112.en: The man with the water gourd, he is a god
112.zh: 那持水葫芦的男子，他是神
112.note: 库皮赫阿说这是“生命之水的卡内”（Kane-i-ka-wai-ola），以涌出的泉水为象征。他认为这一段说的不是草木蔓延，而是人借生育之力繁衍（[[ku:10]]）。Kukahi 本作 *hue-wai*（附录二）。

113.en: Water that causes the withered vine to flourish
113.zh: 水使枯萎的藤蔓重新繁茂

114.en: Causes the plant top to develop freely

115.zh: 须根浸润流水，时光流转
115.note: *paia[‘a]*：Beckwith 说是把水送去浸润块茎的须根。*manawa* 兼有“时光”与“囟门”二义，Pokini 把须根解作经囟门给孩子输送养分的血脉（[[ku:10]]）。

116.note: Beckwith 认为 *he‘e* 在这里指海中生物在水里摇曳、陆上草木在风中摆动，而不是专指章鱼（*he‘e*）或滑行的游戏（[[ku:10]]）。

118.zh: 向这里充盈，向那里充盈
118.note: 本行与下一行依次以 *u、a、e、o* 四个元音收尾；Kukahi 本按英文字母顺序排作 *a、e、o、u*（附录二）。

119.en: Spreading this way, spreading that way
119.zh: 向这边充盈，向那边充盈

120.en: Propping up earth, holding up the sky
120.note: 库皮赫阿读作象征：平民（*honua*）是撑持酋长（*lani*）的支柱。Beckwith 由此问，波利尼西亚推开天地的神话是否也可以这样读作酋长阶层的兴起（[[ku:10]]）。

121.en: The time passes, this night of Kumulipo
121.zh: 时光飘移，这是库穆利波的夜

123.en: Born is a child to Po-wehiwehi
123.note: 第二段的一对生育者：Pouliuli（“深沉的黑暗”，*uliuli* 是深海的颜色）与 Powehiwehi（“透着微光的黑暗”，*wehiwehi* 是密叶下漏进微光的阴影）（[[ku:11]]）。

124.en: Cradled in the arms of Po-uliuli[?]
124.note: 难解之句。*ho‘oleilei*，“抛弄”，Beckwith 联系到 Pukui 祖母所唱的摇篮曲“抛啊，抛啊，嘘——”（[[ku:11]]）。

125.zh: 一个摔跤的，一个推搡的
125.note: Pukui 提议的读法，形容好动的幼儿（[[ku:11]]）。

126.en: Dweller in the land of Poho-mi-luamea
126.note: Pokini Robinson 解释说，以下数行写幼儿随意便溺：孩子弄脏了自己，长辈会叫“Ta! Poho-mi-lua-mea!”，此词由 *poholua*（肛门）与 *mi*（撒尿）构成（[[ku:11]]）。

127.en: The sacred scent from the gourd stem proclaims [itself]
127.zh: 葫芦颈的神圣气味自行宣告

128.en: The stench breaks forth in the time of infancy

129.en: He is doubtful and stands swelling

132.en: Born is the child of the *hilu* fish and swims
132.zh: 生了孩子，如 hilu 鱼，游去
132.note: *hilu*（“优美”）是夏威夷海中色彩最艳丽的两种隆头鱼。旧时称赞婴儿不宜直说，以免招来厄运，于是说“你真是一条 *hilu* 鱼！”；给孩子吃的第一口固体食物若是 hilu 鱼，据说能使他长得好看（[[ku:11]]）。

133.en: The hilu fish rests with spreading tail-fin

134.en: A child of renown for Po-uliuli
134.zh: 是 Pouliuli 声名远扬的孩子

135.zh: 是 Powehiwehi 的小小一个

138.en: Born is the l'a [fish], born the Nai'a [porpoise] in the sea there swimming
138.zh: 生了鱼，生了海豚，在那海中游去
138.note: *i‘a*（鱼）与 *nai‘a*（海豚）谐音相配。以下鱼名大多两两押韵，不少名字今天已难确指。

139.en: Born is the Mano [shark], born the Moano [goatfish] in the sea there swimming
139.zh: 生了鲨鱼，生了羊鱼，在那海中游去

140.en: Born is the Mau, born the Maumau in the sea there swimming
140.zh: 生了 mau，生了 maumau，在那海中游去

141.en: Born is the Nana, born the Mana fish in the sea there swimming
141.zh: 生了 nana，生了 mana，在那海中游去

142.en: Born is the Nake, born the Make in the sea there swimming
142.zh: 生了 nake，生了 make，在那海中游去

143.en: Born is the Napa, born the Nala in the sea there swimming
143.zh: 生了 napa，生了 nala，在那海中游去

144.en: Born is the Pala, born the Kala [sturgeon ?] in the sea there swimming
144.zh: 生了 pala，生了 kala 鱼，在那海中游去
144.note: *kala* 是刺尾鱼科的单角鼻鱼（*Naso*）。Beckwith 括注“sturgeon?”（鲟鱼），夏威夷无鲟鱼，疑是 surgeon（刺尾鱼）之误。

145.en: Born is the Paka eel, born is the Papa [crab] in die sea there swimming
145.zh: 生了 paka 鳗，生了 papa 蟹，在那海中游去

146.en: Born is the Kalakala, born the Huluhulu [sea slug] in the sea there swimming
146.zh: 生了 kalakala，生了 huluhulu 海蛞蝓，在那海中游去

147.en: Born is the Halahala, born the Palapala in the sea there swimming
147.zh: 生了 halahala，生了 palapala，在那海中游去

148.en: Born is the Pe'a [octopus], born is the Lupe [sting ray] in the sea there swimming
148.zh: 生了 pe‘a 章鱼，生了 lupe 鳐，在那海中游去
148.note: *pe‘a* 在第 18 行指海星，这里 Beckwith 译作章鱼。

149.en: Born is the Ao, born is the 'Awa [milkfish] in the sea there swimming
149.zh: 生了 ao，生了遮目鱼，在那海中游去

150.en: Born is the Aku [bonito], born the Ahi [albacore] in the sea there swimming
150.zh: 生了鲣鱼，生了金枪鱼，在那海中游去
150.note: *aku* 是鲣鱼；*‘ahi* 今天多指黄鳍金枪鱼与大眼金枪鱼。

151.en: Born is the Opelu [mackerel], born the Akule fish in the sea there swimming
151.zh: 生了圆鲹，生了大眼鲹，在那海中游去

152.en: Born is the 'Ama'ama [mullet], born the 'Anae [adult mullet] in the sea there swimming
152.zh: 生了鲻鱼，生了长成的鲻鱼，在那海中游去
152.note: 夏威夷人按大小给鲻鱼不同的名字，*‘anae* 是长成的大鲻鱼；鲻鱼是古代鱼塘里最重要的养殖鱼。

153.en: Born is the Ehu, born the Nehu fish. in the sea there swimming
153.zh: 生了 ehu，生了 nehu 小鱼，在那海中游去
153.note: *nehu* 是一种小型鳀鱼，传统上用作钓鲣鱼的活饵。

154.en: Born is the 'Ino, born the 'Ao'ao in the sea there swimming
154.zh: 生了 ‘iao，生了 ‘ao‘ao，在那海中游去

155.en: Born is the 'Ono fish, born the Omo in the sea there swimming
155.zh: 生了刺鲅，生了 omo，在那海中游去

156.en: Born is the Pahau, born is the Lauhau in the sea there swimming
156.zh: 生了 pahau，生了 lauhau，在那海中游去

157.en: Born is the Moi [threadfin], born the Lo'ilo'i in the sea there swimming
157.zh: 生了马鲅，生了 lo‘ilo‘i，在那海中游去
157.note: *moi*（六丝马鲅）旧时是保留给酋长的鱼。

158.en: Born is the Mao, born is the Maomao in the sea there swimming
158.zh: 生了 mao，生了 maomao，在那海中游去

159.en: Born is the Kaku, born the A'ua'u in the sea there swimming
159.zh: 生了魣鱼，生了 a‘ua‘u，在那海中游去

160.en: Born is the Kupou, born the Kupouposu in the sea there swimming
160.zh: 生了 kupou，生了 kupoupou，在那海中游去

161.en: Born is the Weke [mackerel ? ], born the Lele in the sea there swimming
161.zh: 生了 weke 羊鱼，生了 lele，在那海中游去
161.note: *weke* 是羊鱼科的鱼，Beckwith 括注“mackerel?”有误。

162.en: Born is the Palani [sturgeon], born the Nukumoni [cavalla] in the sea there swimming
162.zh: 生了刺尾鱼，生了 nukumomi 鲹，在那海中游去
162.note: *palani* 是一种刺尾鱼；Beckwith 括注的 sturgeon 应是 surgeon（刺尾鱼）之误，参看第 144 行。

163.en: Born is the Ulua fish, born the Hahalua [devilfish] in the sea there swimming
163.zh: 生了浪人鲹，生了蝠鲼，在那海中游去
163.note: *ulua* 即浪人鲹等大型鲹类；*hahalua* 是蝠鲼（英文旧称 devilfish）。

164.en: Born is the 'Ao'aonui born the Paku'iku'i fish in the sea there swimming
164.zh: 生了 ‘ao‘aonui，生了 paku‘iku‘i，在那海中游去

165.en: Born is the Ma'i'i'i fish, born the Ala'ihi fish in the sea there swimming
165.zh: 生了 ma‘i‘i‘i，生了金鳞鱼，在那海中游去

166.en: Born is the 'O'o, born the 'Akilolo fish in the sea there swimming
166.zh: 生了 ‘o‘o，生了 ‘akilolo，在那海中游去

167.en: Born is the Nenue [pickerel] living im the sea
167.note: Beckwith 在此行之前补了一行“Born is man for the narrow stream, the woman for the broad stream”，Kalākaua 本没有。*nenue* 是舵鱼（*Kyphosus*）。

168.en: Guarded by the Lauhue [gourd plant] living on land
168.zh: 由葫芦藤守护，居于陆上

170.note: 叠句中行在本段变为 *he kai ka ‘ai a ka i‘a*，“海是鱼的食物”。Beckwith 只写“Refrain”，没有译出这一变体。

171.en: The god enters, man can not enter

172.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
172.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

173.en: Born is the Pahaha [young mullet] living in the sea

174.en: Guarded by the Puhala [pandanus] living on land
174.zh: 由露兜树守护，居于陆上

177.en: The god enters, man can not enter

178.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
178.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

179.en: Born is the Pahau living in the sea

180.en: Guarded by the Hau tree [hibiscus] living on land
180.zh: 由黄槿树守护，居于陆上
180.note: *hau* 即黄槿（*Hibiscus tiliaceus*），原文作 *Lauhau*（黄槿叶），与上行 *Pahau* 相应。

183.en: The god enters, man can not enter

184.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
184.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

185.en: Born is the He'e [squid] living in the sea
185.note: *he‘e* 通常指章鱼，Beckwith 译作 squid。

186.en: Guarded by the Walahe'e [shrub] living on land
186.zh: 由 walahe‘e 灌木守护，居于陆上

189.en: The god enters, man can not enter

190.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
190.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

191.en: Born is the 'O'opu [gobey fish] living in the sea
191.zh: 生了海中的虾虎鱼，居于海中
191.note: *‘o‘opu-kai* 与 *‘o‘opu-wai*：海中与淡水中的虾虎鱼。

192.en: Guarded by the 'O'opu [fish] living in fresh water
192.zh: 由淡水中的虾虎鱼守护，居于陆上
192.note: 原文仍作 *noho i uka*（居于内陆），Beckwith 英译改为“living in fresh water”。

195.en: The god enters, man can not enter

196.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
196.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

197.en: Born is the Kauila eel living in the sea
197.zh: 生了 kauila 鳗，居于海中

198.en: Guarded by the Kauila tree living on land
198.zh: 由 kauila 树守护，居于陆上
198.note: *kauila*（*Alphitonia ponderosa*）木质极坚硬，旧时用来做长矛与工具。

201.en: The god enters, man can not enter

202.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
202.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

203.en: Born is the Umaumalei eel living in the sea
203.zh: 生了 umaumalei 鳗，居于海中

204.en: Guarded by the 'Ulei tree living on land
204.zh: 由 ‘ulei 树守护，居于陆上

207.en: The god enters, man can not enter

208.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
208.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

209.en: Born is the Paku'iku'i fish living in the sea
209.zh: 生了 paku‘iku‘i 鱼，居于海中

210.en: Guarded by the Kukui tree [candlenut] living on land
210.zh: 由石栗树守护，居于陆上
210.note: *kukui*，石栗，种仁含油，古代串起来点作灯烛。

213.en: The god enters, man can not enter

214.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
214.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

215.en: Born is the Laumilo eel living in the sea
215.zh: 生了 laumilo 鳗，居于海中

216.en: Guarded by the Milo tree living on land
216.zh: 由桐棉树守护，居于陆上

219.en: The god enters, man can not enter

220.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
220.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

221.en: Born is the Kupoupou fish living in the sea
221.zh: 生了 kupoupou 鱼，居于海中

222.en: Guarded by the Kou tree living on land
222.zh: 由 kou 树守护，居于陆上

225.en: The god enters, man can not enter

226.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
226.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

227.en: Born is the Hauliuli [snake mackerel] living in the sea

228.en: Guarded by the Uhi yam living on land

231.en: The god enters, man can not enter

232.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
232.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

233.en: Born is the Weke [mackerel] living in the sea
233.zh: 生了 weke 羊鱼，居于海中

234.en: Guarded by the Wauke plant living on land

237.en: The god enters, man can not enter

238.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
238.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

239.en: Born is the 'A'awa. fish living in the sea

240.en: Guarded by the 'Awa plant living on land
240.note: *‘awa*，卡瓦胡椒（*Piper methysticum*），其根制成的饮料用于祭神与待客。

243.en: The god enters, man can not enter

244.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
244.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

245.en: Born is the Ulae [lizard fish] living in the sea

246.en: Guarded by the Mokae rush living on land
246.zh: 由 mokae 灯心草守护，居于陆上

249.en: The god enters, man can not enter

250.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
250.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

251.en: Born is the Palaoa [walrus] living in the sea [?]
251.note: *palaoa* 通常指抹香鲸，以及用鲸齿雕成、酋长佩戴的颈饰（*lei palaoa*）。Beckwith 译作 walrus（海象），并打了问号；夏威夷海域没有海象。

252.en: Guarded by the Aoa [sandalwood] living on land
252.zh: 由 aoa 檀香守护，居于陆上

255.en: The god enters, man can not enter

256.en: The train of walruses passing by [?]
256.note: 以下尾声在海底世界与幽深山谷之间穿梭：深谷是古代神灵的居处，高等级酋长之子被送到那里抚养，以保全其禁忌等级（[[ku:11]]）。

257.en: Milling about in the depths of the sea

258.en: The long lines of opule fish
258.note: *‘opule* 是一种色彩鲜艳的隆头鱼（[[ku:11]]）。

259.en: The sea is thick with them

262.en: Rising and diving under swiftly and silently
262.zh: 沿着 Kolomio 之路，倏然潜没
262.note: *kolomio* 与 *miomio* 状鱼儿迅疾地潜入水下（[[ku:11]]）。

263.zh: 皮莫埃潜伏在天际之外
263.note: 皮莫埃（Pimoe）是可变形、性别不定的神异之物，传说中的英雄为她的女身出海垂钓；有人称她是“卡内的隐岛”的守护者。*Polikua*（“凹背”）是天际线下目力不及的凹处（[[ku:11]]）。

264.en: On the long waves, the crested waves
264.zh: 在长浪上，在浪峰卷起的浪上
264.note: 原文 *O Hikawainui, o Hikawaina*，形式上像两个名字。

267.en: The little ones seek the dark places
267.zh: 幼小者寻向幽深的海流

268.en: Very dark is the ocean and obscure

269.en: A sea of coral like the green heights of Paliuli
269.zh: 一片珊瑚之海，如帕利乌利的青翠高地
269.note: 帕利乌利（Paliuli）是神灵的常青之地，食物不劳而生。深山中曾被选作抚养高等级酋长子女的幽僻之处也称 Paliuli（[[ku:11]]）。

271.en: Covered by the darkness of night

273.en: A male this, the female that
273.note: 第三段的一对生育者：Po‘ele‘ele（“黑夜”）与 Pohaha（“破晓之夜”）。*Pohaha* 与 *pohá*（迸发、乍现）双关，如 *Pohá mai ka la*，“太阳迸出”（[[ku:12]]）。手稿中本段在鱼与林木一段之前（附录二）。

274.en: A male born in the time of black darkness

275.en: The female born in the time of groping in the darkness
275.zh: 女生于黑暗中摸索的时代
275.note: *po-haha*：*haha* 又有“摸索”之义，Beckwith 在此取这一义。

276.en: Overshadowed was the sea, overshadowed the land
276.zh: 大海被遮蔽，陆地被遮蔽

277.en: Overshadowed the streams, overshadowed the mountains
277.zh: 溪水被遮蔽，群山被遮蔽

279.en: The rootstalk grew forming nine leaves
279.zh: 根茎生长，长出九片叶子
279.note: 库皮赫阿认为本序曲以芋头抽芽比喻酋长阶层的兴起；“九叶”即“瓦凯亚的九个女儿”，由她们分出九支禁忌酋长（[[ku:12]]）。

280.en: Upright it grew with dark leaves
280.note: 库皮赫阿说“深色的叶”（*lau pahiwa*）、“高等级酋长之叶”与“根茎抽出的芽”专指 Uli 一系，毛伊岛和夏威夷岛的酋长都从这一系上溯祖先（[[ku:12]]）。

281.en: The sprout that shot forth leaves of high chiefs
281.zh: 嫩芽抽出，长出高等酋长之叶

284.en: The rootstalk sprouted / The taro stalk grew
284.note: Beckwith 把这一行译成两行（“The rootstalk sprouted / The taro stalk grew”）。Kalākaua 本作 *Hanuu kupua*，她依 Kukahi 本改（附录二）。

285.en: Born was the Wood borer, a parent
285.note: 以下先是昆虫，后是鸟，亲与子的名字也多半谐音相配（[[ku:12]]）。

286.en: Out came its child a flying thing, and flew

287.en: Born was the Caterpillar, the parent

288.en: Out came its child a Moth, and flew

289.en: Born was the Ant, the parent

290.en: Out came its child a Dragonfly, and flew

291.en: Born was the Grub, the parent

292.en: Out came its child the Grasshopper, and flew

293.en: Born was the Pinworm, the parent

294.en: Out came its child a Fly, and flew

295.en: Born was the egg [?], the parent
295.note: *Hualua*：*hua* 是“卵、果实”，Beckwith 译作 egg 并打了问号。

296.en: Out came its child a bird, and flew

297.en: Born was the Snipe, the parent
297.note: *‘ulili* 今指漂泊鹬；下行 *kolea* 是太平洋金斑鸻，每年秋天从北方飞来过冬，春天离去。

298.en: Out came its child a Plover, and flew

299.en: Born was the A'o bird, the parent
299.note: *‘a‘o* 是一种夜间归巢的鹱。Kukahi 本缺第 299–300 行（附录二）。

300.en: Out came its child an A'u bird, and flew
300.zh: 其子 ‘a‘u 鸟出来了，飞去

301.en: Born was the Turnstone, the parent

302.en: Out came its child a Fly-catcher, and flew
302.zh: 其子 ‘elepaio 鹟出来了，飞去
302.note: *‘elepaio* 是夏威夷特有的王鹟，传说中造舟匠人跟着它挑选木材。

303.en: Born was the Mudhen, the parent

304.en: Out came its child an Apapane bird, and flew
304.zh: 其子 ‘apapane 鸟出来了，飞去
304.note: *‘apapane* 是一种红色的夏威夷管舌雀。

305.en: Born was the Crow, the parent
305.note: *‘alala* 即夏威夷乌鸦，野外一度绝迹，主要靠人工繁育延续。

306.en: Out came its child an Alawi bird, and flew
306.zh: 其子 alawi 鸟出来了，飞去

307.en: Born was the 'E'ea bird, the parent

308.en: Out came its child an Alaaiaha bird, and flew
308.zh: 其子 alaiaha 鸟出来了，飞去

309.en: Born was the Mamo honey-sucker, the parent
309.zh: 生了 mamo 吸蜜鸟，是为亲
309.note: *mamo* 与下行的 *‘o‘o* 都以黄色羽毛著称，用来制作酋长的羽毛斗篷；夏威夷岛的 mamo 与 ‘o‘o 后来都已灭绝。

310.en: Out came its child an 'O'o bird, and flew
310.zh: 其子 ‘o‘o 鸟出来了，飞去

311.en: Born was the Rail, the parent
311.note: Kukahi 本缺第 311–314 行（附录二）。

312.en: Out came its child a brown Albatross, and flew
312.zh: 其子褐色的信天翁出来了，飞去

313.en: Born was the Akikiki creeper, the parent
313.zh: 生了 ‘akikiki 旋木雀，是为亲

314.en: Out came its child an Ukihi bird, and flew
314.zh: 其子 ukihi 鸟出来了，飞去

315.en: Born was the Curlew, the parent

316.en: Out came its child a Stilt, and flew
316.zh: 其子长脚鹬出来了，飞去

317.en: Born was the Frigate bird, the parent
317.note: *‘iwa*，军舰鸟，常抢夺别的海鸟口中之食；下行 *koa‘e* 是鹲（热带鸟）。Kalākaua 本作 *ke kaiwa*（附录二）。

318.en: Out came its child a Tropic bird, and flew

319.en: Born was the migrating gray-backed Tern, the parent
319.zh: 生了迁徙的灰背燕鸥，是为亲

320.en: Out came its child a red-tailed Tropic-bird, and flew
320.zh: 其子红尾鹲出来了，飞去

321.en: Born was the Unana bird, the parent
321.zh: 生了 unana 鸟，是为亲

322.en: Its offspring the Heron came out and flew
322.note: 库皮赫阿认为诗中有些段落是为夸耀卡拉卡瓦的高贵出身、回击当时的诋毁者而插入的，并举此处为例：夜鹭（*auku‘u*）成群蹲在沙洲上鬼鬼祟祟张望，常被比作怕人偷听的阴谋者。Beckwith 指出，即便有影射当时的意思，也不能证明是新插入的（[[ku:12]]）。

325.en: Settled down and covered the beach

326.zh: 覆满了卡内胡纳莫库之地
326.note: 卡内胡纳莫库（Kane-huna-moku），“卡内的隐岛”，传说中漂浮在天际之外的神之岛。

329.en: Man born for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
329.zh: 生了男，属窄流之水；女，属宽流之水

330.en: Born was the Stingray, living in the sea
330.note: *lupe* 兼指鳐鱼与风筝，与下行的鸟名 *lupeakeke* 相配。Kukahi 本缺第 330–331 行（附录二）。

331.en: Guarded by the Stormy-petrel living on land

333.note: 叠句中行在本段变为 *He hua, he ‘i‘o ka ‘ai a ka manu*。Beckwith 只写“Refrain”，未译出；她在第 9 章提到此处的 *hua*（果实）与 *‘i‘o*（肉）（[[ku:9]]）。

334.en: The god enters, man can not enter

335.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
335.zh: 生了男，属窄流之水；女，属宽流之水
335.note: 原文此处作 *Hanau kane…*（生了男），Beckwith 英译与其他各节一样作“Man for the narrow stream”。

336.en: Born was the Sea-swallow, living at sea
336.zh: 生了 noio 燕鸥，居于海中

337.en: Guarded by the Hawk living on land

340.en: The god enters, man can not enter

341.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
341.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

342.en: Born was the Duck of the islands, living at sea
342.zh: 生了海岛的 kolea 鸟，居于海中
342.note: 原文 *Kolea-a-moku* 与下行 *Kolea-lele*，Beckwith 都译作鸭；*kolea* 通常指金斑鸻。

343.en: Guarded by the Wild-duck living on land
343.zh: 由飞翔的 kolea 鸟守护，居于陆上

346.en: The god enters, man can not enter

347.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
347.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

348.en: Born was the Hehe, living at sea

349.en: Guarded by the Nene [goose] living on land
349.note: *nene*，夏威夷黑雁，夏威夷特有的雁，今为州鸟。

352.en: The god enters, man can not enter

353.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
353.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

354.en: Born was the Auku'u, living by the sea

355.en: Guarded by the Ekupu'u bird living on land
355.zh: 由 ‘ekupu‘u 鸟守护，居于陆上

358.en: The god enters, man can not enter

359.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
359.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

360.en: Born was the Noddy [*noio*], living at sea
360.zh: 生了 noio 燕鸥，居于海中

361.en: Guarded by the Owl [*pueo*] living on land
361.zh: 由猫头鹰守护，居于陆上
361.note: *pueo*，夏威夷的短耳鸮，许多家族奉为守护祖灵（*‘aumakua*）。

364.en: The god enters, man can not enter

365.en: This is the flying place of the bird Halulu
365.zh: 这是 Halulu 鸟飞跃之地
365.note: Halulu 与其配偶 Kiwa‘a 的羽毛系在神像上，据说其起伏能预示出征的胜败；传说中有英雄杀死食人鸟 Halulu 与 Kiwa‘a。*leina* 是“跃下之处”（[[ku:12]]）。

366.en: Of Kiwa'a, the bird that cries over the canoe house
366.zh: 是 Kiwa‘a，在长屋上啼鸣的鸟
366.note: 古谚称 Halulu 为“在长屋（*halau*）上啼鸣的鸟”。*Kiwa‘a* 谐音 *Kia‘i-wa‘a*（“导舟者”），指领群的引航鸟：它总在同一处登岸，渔人便在那里搭舟棚，在远海也能循它的航向回家（[[ku:12]]）。

367.en: Birds that fly in a flock shutting out the sun
367.zh: 成群飞翔的鸟，遮住了太阳

368.en: The earth is covered with the fledgelings of the night breaking into dawn
368.zh: 大地满是破晓之夜的雏鸟
368.note: *pohaha*，“破晓之夜”，即本段的女性生育者之名（[[ku:12]]）。

369.en: The time when the dawning light spreads abroad
369.zh: 是曙光散布四方的时代

370.note: *‘ape*，海芋，叶片巨大，形似芋头。Beckwith 认为诗人在这一尾声里借遍布海陆的鸟群，重构了移民一波波来到夏威夷的时代，随后陡然回到“根茎”*Haha*（[[ku:12]]）。

371.en: A tender plant with spreading leaves

372.en: A branching out of the nightborn

376.en: A time of dawn indeed for Pohaha
376.zh: 确是破晓之时，属于 Pohaha，这夜

378.en: Plant the *'ahi'a* and cause it to propagate
378.note: Beckwith 说这几行她是照字面译的。Kukahi 本作 *ke ahi a La‘a la*，利留卡拉尼据此译为“La‘a 之火”；译者多把开头联系到传说中“来自卡希基的 La‘a”的到来，但她无法把“生火”与这种读法对上（[[ku:13]]、附录二）。

379.note: 有人读作“来自海外的大酋长”，即把“暗黑的 *‘ape*”指为一次具体的移民（[[ku:13]]）。

380.en: The sea creeps up to the land
380.note: 第四段写两栖之物“从海中上岸”。库皮赫阿把这一系列与迁徙时代的移民家族相联系，Pokini 则说是孩子开始爬行、经受磕碰的阶段；Beckwith 大体从库皮赫阿之说（[[ku:13]]）。

381.zh: 向那边爬去，向这边爬来

384.en: Advancing the front, settling down at the back

385.en: The front of my cherished one [?]

387.en: Popanopano is born as a male [?]
387.note: Kalākaua 本与手稿作 *Kaneaka Papanopano*，Kukahi 本作 *kane a ka po panopano*（附录二）。

388.note: 第四段的一对生育者是 Popanopano（*panopano*，深暗）与 Polalowehi。

390.en: Gave birth to those who produce eggs

391.en: Produce and multiply in the passing night
391.zh: 产卵繁衍，在流逝的夜里

392.note: Kukahi 本把本行与下一行写作一行（附录二）。

394.en: The children roll about, play in the sand
394.zh: 孩子们翻滚着，在沙中嬉戏

395.en: Child of the night of black darkness is born

397.en: The night gives birth to prolific ones
397.note: 以下各行大多以内韵两两成对，每行各自成句，后一行与前一行相平衡而不相承接（[[ku:13]]）。

398.en: The night is swollen with plump creatures

399.en: The night gives birth to rough-backed turtles
399.zh: 夜生出背壳粗糙的海龟
399.note: *honu* 是绿海龟，下行 *‘ea* 是玳瑁。

401.en: The night gives birth to dark-red turtles
401.note: *‘ula* 通常指龙虾；Beckwith 此行译作暗红色的龟，下行译作小龙虾。

402.en: The night is pregnant with the small lobster

403.en: The night gives birth to sluggish-moving geckos
403.zh: 夜生出缓缓爬行的蜥蜴
403.note: *mo‘o*，蜥蜴、壁虎，也指传说中的龙形水怪。Kukahi 本缺第 403–412 行（附录二）。

404.en: Slippery is the night with sleek-skinned geckos
404.zh: 夜滑溜溜，满是皮肤光润的蜥蜴

405.en: The night gives birth to clinging creatures
405.note: Pokini 把以下各名读作婴儿成长的写照：“攀附”（*pilipili*）着父母，又被“粗暴地”（*kalakala*）分开；“受斥责”（*ka‘uka‘u*）、“健忘”（*palaka*）、渐渐“自立”（*kaihukunini*）、“得食”（*kupelepele*）、长得“丰满”（*kele*）（[[ku:13]]）。

407.en: The night gives birth to deliberate creatures

408.en: The night shrinks from the ineffective

409.en: The night gives birth to sharp-nosed creatures

410.en: Hollowed is the night for great fat ones

411.en: The night gives birth to mud dwellers

412.en: The night lingers for track leavers

413.en: Born is the male for the narrow stream, the female for the broad stream
413.zh: 生了男，属窄流之水；女，属宽流之水

414.en: Born is the turtle [*Honu*] living in the sea

415.en: Guarded by the *Maile* seedling [*Kubonua*] living on land
415.zh: 由 maile 幼苗守护，居于陆上
415.note: 原文 *Kuhonua*（英文底本误作 Kubonua），Beckwith 释为 *maile* 藤的幼苗；*maile* 是芳香的藤本，用来编织花环。

417.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物
417.note: 叠句中行在本段变为 *he la‘i ka ‘ai a kolo*，Beckwith 未译出。*la‘i* 在这里的意思不能确定，此处姑且按 *lā‘ī*（*lau kī* 即朱蕉叶的缩略）译作“叶”；*la‘i* 又有“平静”之义。

418.en: The god enters, man can not enter

419.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
419.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

420.en: Born is the sea-borer [*Wili*] living in the sea
420.zh: 生了海中钻木虫，居于海中

421.en: Guarded by the Wiliwili tree living on land
421.note: *wiliwili*，夏威夷刺桐（*Erythrina sandwicensis*），木质轻，用来做冲浪板与独木舟的浮杆。

423.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

424.en: The god enters, man can not enter

425.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
425.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

426.en: Born is the sea-worm living in the sea

427.en: Guarded by the bastard-sandalwood living on land
427.zh: 由 naio 假檀香守护，居于陆上
427.note: *naio*（*Myoporum sandwicense*）木材有香气，曾被当作檀香的代用品，故称假檀香。

429.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

430.en: The god enters, man can not enter

431.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
431.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

432.en: Born is the Okea living in the sea

433.en: Guarded by the Ahakea tree living on land
433.zh: 由 ahakea 树守护，居于陆上

435.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

436.en: The god enters, man can not enter

437.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
437.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

438.en: Born is the sea-urchin [*Wana*] living in the sea

439.en: Guarded by the thorny Wanawana plant living on land
439.zh: 由多刺的 wanawana 守护，居于陆上

441.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

442.en: The god enters, man can not enter

443.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
443.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

444.en: Born is the Nene shellfish living in the sea
444.zh: 生了 nene 贝，居于海中

445.en: Guarded by the Manene grass living on land
445.zh: 由 manene 草守护，居于陆上

447.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

448.en: The god enters, man can not enter

449.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
449.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

450.en: Born is the Liko living in the sea

451.en: Guarded by the Piko tree living on land
451.zh: 由 piko 树守护，居于陆上

453.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

454.en: The god enters, man can not enter

455.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
455.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

456.en: Born is the Opeope jellyfish living in the sea

457.en: Guarded by the Oheohe [bamboo] living on land

459.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

460.en: The god enters, man can not enter

461.en: Man for the narrow stream, woman for the broad stream
461.zh: 男属窄流之水，女属宽流之水

462.en: Born is the Nanana [sea spider] living in the sea

463.en: Guarded by the Nonanona living on land
463.zh: 由 nonanona 守护，居于陆上

465.zh: 土与叶，是爬行者的食物

466.en: The god enters, man can not enter

467.en: With a dancing motion they go creeping and crawling
467.zh: 以舞蹈般的姿态，它们蠕动爬行
467.note: 尾声写这些半海半陆之物的污秽与迟缓。若照库皮赫阿把它当作一次历史上的移民来读，Beckwith 说那是对过去“相当难堪的控诉”；照 Pokini 读作幼儿，则更多是诙谐（[[ku:13]]）。

468.zh: 尾巴摇摆，拖着长长的身子

470.en: They go poking about the dunghill
470.zh: 它们在粪堆里四处拱弄

471.en: Filth is their food, they devour it
471.zh: 污秽是它们的食物，它们吞吃

472.en: Eat and rest, eat and belch it up
472.zh: 吃了就歇，吃了又打嗝吐出

473.note: 原文 *kauwa*，指世袭的贱民阶层，Beckwith 译作“common people”。

475.en: They move about and become heated

478.en: Go in the land of crawlers

479.en: The family of crawlers born in the night
